errors.what: Panel piston_x disagrees with spec (r=40, l=120). At theta=0 the spec gives 160 mm and at 180 deg 80 mm, but the panel shows 172.00 and 92.00 mm. At 90 deg the spec gives 113.14 mm, but the panel shows 125.79 mm. All values fit a rod length of about 132 mm (ratio 3.3), not 120 mm (ratio 3.0). The rod looks too long in the frames, so the rod length is wrong.
